title: Beyond Chain-of-Thought: Theory-Grounded Approaches to Elicit Deep Reasoning in LLMs

contributions.purpose: 论证 CoT 揭示模型真实推理的根本局限
contributions.mechanism: 信息论瓶颈+数据处理不等式推导表征/泛化界
contributions.evaluation: 定理1 互信息界 I(H_L;C)≤log2(k)+ε;推论1 泛化误差 Ω(2^{d/k})(纯推导,无实证)
contributions.source_quote: We provide a theoretical framework demonstrating the fundamental limitations of CoT reasoning, including formal bounds on its generalization capabilities.

contributions.purpose: 提出两种替代 CoT 的推理激发方法
contributions.mechanism: MRE(因果干预计算图路径)+ CAR(范畴论组合抽象)
contributions.evaluation: CAR 组合泛化误差界 ≤2ε+O(ε²)(定理9);MRE 梯度近似省 90% 计算保 85% 路径发现精度(自述,无对照实验)
contributions.source_quote: We propose two novel approaches: Mechanistic Reasoning Elicitation (MRE) based on causal intervention theory, and Compositional Abstraction Reasoning (CAR) grounded in category theory.

contributions.purpose: 为两方法建立理论保证并声称实证验证
contributions.mechanism: 手工构造的模态逻辑/因果/组合泛化 case study
contributions.evaluation: 声称 benchmark 上 superior performance,但第6节仅 5 个手算例子(如因果 Δ=0.31/0.47,信息保存比≥0.85),无数据集实验
contributions.source_quote: We establish theoretical guarantees for both methods and demonstrate their superior performance across reasoning benchmarks with concrete empirical validation.

self_declared_provenance.quote: Our work extends this critique specifically to chain-of-thought reasoning and provides constructive alternatives.
Our MRE method builds on these foundations while focusing specifically on reasoning tasks.
We extend these approaches to reasoning-specific contexts.

notes: 数据红旗:abstract/贡献3 号称 concrete empirical validation 与 superior performance across reasoning benchmarks,但全文无任何数据集实验,第6节只是手工构造的 case study 且数字(Δ=0.31、信息保存≥0.85、路径精度85%)无来源;checklist 自曝矛盾——reproducibility 答 Yes(理由仅'mathematical examples'),open access 与 experimental settings 均答 NA 并称'The paper is theory based and does not contain experimental results',即 AI 自我披露无实验却在正文声称实证(幻影实证)。定理证明多为一句话手挥式(如'proof follows from the bottleneck principle')。自声明贡献 threefold,四元组按其列表。trade-off:作者承认 MRE 计算随模型规模二次增长、对超大 LLM 不可行。
